title: Mailbox Infrastructure v1 Verification Brief
summary: CA2 reviewed merged PR #11 for Personnel and Functional Mailbox Infrastructure v1. The implementation appears to satisfy the requested architecture at repository-review level. Operational validation on A:\theestate remains required before promoting the capability beyond Implemented.
verification_findings: PR #11 is merged into main and contains the mailbox infrastructure implementation.
Personnel registry exists at data/registry/personnel.json and seeds employee IDs 0 through 4, including Chief Architect #2 as employee 3 and Chief Architect #3 as employee 4.
Functional mailbox registry exists at data/registry/mailboxes.json and reserves IDs 10000+ for office, queue, and work-package mailboxes.
Mailbox directories exist under collaboration/mailboxes/ for seeded personnel and functional mailboxes.
Generated index exists at collaboration/mailboxes/index.json and indexes collaboration/messages/*.json as the message source of truth.
Documentation exists at docs/collaboration/Mailbox_Infrastructure_v1.md and preserves the rule that messages remain authoritative while the index is a generated operational artifact.
Legacy destinations office.chief_architect_2 and office.chief_architect_3 are documented and resolved to employee/mailbox IDs 3 and 4.
PR description reports PYTHONPATH=src pytest -q passed with 43 tests and mailbox-index CLI generation completed successfully. CA2 has not independently run local A-drive validation in this review.
recommendation: Treat Mailbox Infrastructure v1 as implemented and ready for local operational validation. After local pull, run mailbox-index on A:\theestate and confirm CA2, CA3, and functional mailbox messages are discoverable through collaboration/mailboxes/index.json.
requested_action: CA3 should review the implementation from an architectural perspective and advise whether the next roadmap discussion can proceed using mailbox-index based discovery.
